intro: Bethor's Scroll contains magical incantations scribed by Bethor Iceshard to counter the dark sorcery of his former colleague, Thule Ravenclaw. Created to aid Apothecary Renferrel in brewing a protective draught, the scroll is vital for surviving the Scourge necromancy guarding Fenris Isle.

p: Upon examining tainted ichor recovered from Rot Hide gnolls, Bethor Iceshard recognized the handiwork of Thule Ravenclaw. Once a promising young mage of the Kirin Tor, Thule betrayed his brethren to serve the Lich King when the Scourge rose to power. Learning that Thule had survived and was directing Rot Hide attacks across Silverpine Forest from Fenris Isle, Bethor drew upon his intimate knowledge of his former colleague's spellcraft to author this scroll.
